Main Drive Motor.name: Iron
Main Drive Motor.reasoning: Core component of the magnetic circuit in the motor to concentrate magnetic flux, widely used but some specialty steels may be alternatives.

Control Panel And Electronic Control Uni.name: Silicon
Control Panel And Electronic Control Uni.reasoning: Fundamental semiconductor material for integrated circuits and electronic components, absolutely essential.

Control Panel And Electronic Control Uni.name: Copper
Control Panel And Electronic Control Uni.reasoning: Critical for printed circuit board traces and interconnections, standard in electronics.

Control Panel And Electronic Control Uni.name: Aluminum
Control Panel And Electronic Control Uni.reasoning: Used in some heat sinks and structural elements, moderately common with alternatives.

Control Panel And Electronic Control Uni.name: Polycarbonate
Control Panel And Electronic Control Uni.reasoning: Common polymer for control panel housing due to durability and electrical insulation; multiple plastic options exist.

Cam Track System.name: Tool steel
Cam Track System.reasoning: Main material for cam tracks needing wear resistance and strength under cyclic loads.

Cam Track System.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Cam Track System.reasoning: Used for corrosion resistance and durability in cam track parts, common but less wear resistant than tool steel.

Cam Track System.name: Aluminum
Cam Track System.reasoning: Sometimes used for lightweight cam track components; less common and alternatives exist.

Compression Roller Or Cam System.name: Tool steel
Compression Roller Or Cam System.reasoning: Primary material for compression rollers for wear resistance and strength.

Compression Roller Or Cam System.name: Tungsten carbide
Compression Roller Or Cam System.reasoning: Coating or inserts for extremely high wear resistance in rollers; common but more costly.

Compression Roller Or Cam System.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Compression Roller Or Cam System.reasoning: Used for corrosion resistance and structural components; alternatives available.

Feeding System (hopper And Feeder).name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Feeding System (hopper And Feeder).reasoning: Primary material for hopper and feeder due to corrosion resistance and food-grade standards.

Feeding System (hopper And Feeder).name: Aluminum
Feeding System (hopper And Feeder).reasoning: Used in lightweight parts of feeding system; alternatives possible.

Feeding System (hopper And Feeder).name: Polyethylene
Feeding System (hopper And Feeder).reasoning: Polymer sometimes used for non-structural feeder components for chemical resistance; alternatives exist.

Tablet Discharge And Collection System.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Tablet Discharge And Collection System.reasoning: Key material for discharge and collection system for corrosion resistance and hygiene compliance.

Tablet Discharge And Collection System.name: Aluminum
Tablet Discharge And Collection System.reasoning: Used in lightweight or auxiliary components; alternative material dependent on design.

Tablet Discharge And Collection System.name: Polyethylene
Tablet Discharge And Collection System.reasoning: Sometimes used for chutes or collection trays due to chemical resistance and ease of cleaning; alternatives exist.

Machine Frame And Housing.name: Steel Ingots
Machine Frame And Housing.reasoning: Primary raw material for frame manufacturing providing strength and rigidity.

Machine Frame And Housing.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Machine Frame And Housing.reasoning: Used especially where corrosion resistance and hygiene are required on housing surfaces.

Machine Frame And Housing.name: Aluminum
Machine Frame And Housing.reasoning: Used to reduce weight in some frame and housing parts; alternatives exist.
